summary: Recent coverage highlights representation and fiscal matters affecting the District, with headlines addressing taxation, budget concerns, and population comparisons to states, alongside separate reporting on National Guard deployment and other local issues. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.
